name: Sixty-Three
description: 63 (Sixty-Three): four players in two partnerships. 9 cards each then bid (40-63); 4 more cards then discard to 6. Only trump cards score (A=1, K=25, 9=9, 5=5, 3=15, etc; total 63). Make bid to score; first to 152 or 250 wins.

history.origins: American Pedro family; 63 points in trump cards (J=15, 9=9, A=1, K=25, etc.). North-east USA and Canada; related to 83 (with joker).
timeline: 20th century: American Pedro family game; 63 points in trump; played in North-east USA and Canada.
